description: Geometries (Angstrom, sto-3g, singlet) behind the molecular results in arXiv:2604.07156v1 (data/results_optimal/). The original .hdf5 inputs were lost; these geometries were recovered on 2026-09-29 by matching grouping-independent quantities saved by the Dec 2025 runs: the Hartree-Fock energy, and the sum of c_i^2 over Pauli terms containing X or Y (equal to the sum of the saved HF-state per-group sigma^2). They are recorded for traceability only; new results use the CCCBDB geometries in compute/generate_molecules.py.

LiH.evidence: E_HF exact; X/Y coefficient sum 5e-15; all 8 saved variances reproduced to 1e-14

BeH2.evidence: E_HF 1e-13; X/Y coefficient sum 1e-15; term and group counts match

H6.evidence: E_HF 4e-15; X/Y coefficient sum 8e-16; term count match

H2O.evidence: E_HF exact; X/Y coefficient sum 8e-15; 50/50 groups; identical to OpenFermion testing/data/geometry_example.txt

CH4.evidence: E_HF root at r = 0.63*sqrt(3); term count match; X/Y sum not usable (degenerate orbitals)

NH3.evidence: E_HF 1e-12; X/Y coefficient sum 5e-15; term count match. No literature source found; HNH angle ~113 deg (experimental 106.67)
